🥚 STEAL A STRANGE EGG 🥚
Sneak past the sleeping guardians, STEAL their eggs and run back to your base before they wake up! Hatch adorable creatures that make you rich, train your speed and unlock crazier zones.

🆕 HUGE UPDATE: 5 NEW ZONES!
🍭 Candy Land - Gingerbread Giant
🎃 Haunted Graveyard - Pumpkin King
💎 Crystal Caverns - Crystal Golem
🤖 Cyber City - Mech Titan
👼 Heaven - the Archangel
25 brand-new creatures to collect in the Index!

🔫 NEW WEAPONS: Hyperlaser, Freeze Ray, Killer Whale Launcher, Black Hole Gun and Ban Hammer. Hit a thief and they DROP the egg!
👑 Join the community and claim the exclusive Crown Lion at the sign!
⚡ ADMIN ABUSE every day at 18:00 (Paris time): x2 everything for everyone!
🎁 Starter Pack, VIP, Fast Steal, server Admin Abuse and Egg Rain!

👍 Like and favorite for more updates!
